text:
ira: FYI — support flagged a cluster where SSE clients hit server idle-close during chunked uploads and immediately re-open. Console shows two billed sessions.

ben: I pulled traces. Looks like the edge sends a 204 keep-alive then server closes for idle at 60s, client re-opens without resume header.

mike: Example edge log (redacted):
```
[11:14:59.000] EDGE: send keepalive chunk session=rx-55 bytes=0
[11:15:00.001] SERVER: idle_close session=rx-55 reason=idle_timeout
[11:15:00.120] CLIENT: EventSource reconnect headers: origin=..., x-client-fp=fp-55  # no x-resume-token
```

sara: Console attribution ties everything to session id. When resume fails we emit two session rows; users see two billed lines and support tickets spike.

ben: Root cause appears to be twofold: (1) proxy/edge sometimes strips non-standard headers on very fast reconnects, and (2) client libs may not reattach cookie-based tokens on EventSource re-open.

ira: Short-term mitigation: increase idle-close for upload-heavy tenants from 60s -> 90s to reduce churn. Also enable header-debug logging for a small cohort for 48h.

mike: Medium-term: runtime telemetry changes: emit events resume_probe, resume_absent, resume_recovered. Add trace attributes: resume_header_seen=true|false and transport=eventsource|ws. That gives billing & console a reliable signal.

billing-bot: Proposed billing rule: if B reconnects within 4s of A AND same auth-subject AND same client-fp AND tokens(B) < 80 AND resume_header_seen=false AND runtime emitted resume_absent, then mark B as transient_chain and credit B. Log billing_action=transient_chain_credit. Legal review required.

sara: Console UX: group near-duplicate sessions with badge "merged transient reconnect" and an expand arrow to show raw events. Default state: collapsed. Add link "audit raw events" for support.

ira: Security note — only accept chain hints if client-fp + auth token match last active session to prevent spoofing. Emit chain_verified=true|false in telemetry.

ben: Edge fix: ensure passthrough of x-resume-token and x-chain-hint on upgrade/handshake paths. Add integration asserts to CI.

mike: I'll add the telemetry events and trace attrs this sprint. Also add an internal metric counting resume_absent -> resumed_without_token occurrences.

sara: I'll prototype the grouping UI and the audit view.

billing-bot: I'll draft the RFC for the billing heuristic and wire an alert: transient_chain_credit rate > 0.15% of billed tokens triggers investigation.

deploy-bot: Plan: edge header passthrough canary -> Tue 05:00 UTC; runtime telemetry -> Wed 09:00 UTC; console prototype -> next sprint.

ira: Action items: ben -> edge debug + canary; mike -> telemetry events + metric; sara -> console prototype; billing-bot -> RFC + alert; I'll coordinate with support and flip idle-close for cohort. Follow-up sync in #eng-platform tomorrow.

deploy-bot: incident-note INC-2026-801 created: "chunked-keepalive -> fast reconnects causing duplicate sessions" (severity: low)
